annotations.title: Web Content to RSS 2.0 & Atom Feed Compiler

description: Transforms JSON item collections or article card arrays into standardized RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed 1.1 syndication feeds. Use when syndicating blog articles, product announcements, or changelog cards to RSS readers and AI agents; for compiling structured sitemap listings, use crawl_sitemap_urls instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'items_json' and 'channel_title' ('feed_standard' defaults to 'rss_2_0'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

channel_title.description: Headline title for the syndication feed channel.

feed_standard.description: Target syndication feed specification: RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed 1.1.

items_json.description: JSON string representing an array of article or feed items with title, link, and pubDate.

name: compile_rss_feed

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for compile_rss_feed.

content_type.description: Standard MIME content type for the generated feed document.

feed_xml.description: Formatted XML or JSON string ready for publication to feed subscribers.

item_count.description: Number of feed entries compiled into the syndicated document.

title: Web Content to RSS 2.0 & Atom Feed Compiler
